name: Identity Vouched By
description: The signing identity recorded in this Rekor entry was vouched for by an OIDC issuer — Fulcio bound the short-lived signing cert to an identity from this issuer. Hotlink-backed (mode exact): the edge's hotlink.value mirrors rekor_log_entry.signing_identity_issuer, so the edge cannot drift from the field. Converges with the AWS federation path on the same oidc_issuer node.
